# Bookshelf

> A curated collection of recommended books

This is a personal bookshelf web application showcasing book recommendations organized by category. Each book entry includes the title, author, personal notes, notable quotes, and links to Goodreads and Amazon.

## Full Content

For the complete markdown version with all book details, notes, and quotes, see:
- /llms.md

## Categories

- Culture
- Design  
- Engineering
- Thinking

## About

This bookshelf is a React web application. The markdown version at /llms.md is optimized for LLMs and AI assistants.
